title: What is Error Handling?
overview: Error handling is the process of identifying and managing errors in a program. It prevents applications from crashing and helps provide better user experiences.

example.title: Error Example

title: try...catch Statement
overview: The try...catch statement is used to handle runtime errors. Code inside try is executed, and if an error occurs, catch handles that error.

example.title: try...catch Example

title: throw Statement
overview: The throw statement allows developers to create custom errors manually when specific conditions are not satisfied.

example.title: throw Example

title: Error Handling in Async Code
overview: Errors in asynchronous operations can be handled using try...catch with async await or using catch with Promises.

example.title: Async Error Handling

title: Topic Summary
overview: You learned how JavaScript handles errors using try...catch, throw statements, and error handling techniques for asynchronous operations.

example.title: Quick Revision
example.content:
✔ Error handling prevents crashes.
✔ try runs risky code.
✔ catch handles errors.
✔ throw creates custom errors.
✔ Async errors can be handled with try...catch.
